decisions.reason: A mitred lever family with several models represents substantial tooling and finishing investment that the firm has kept on its website, so writing it off after only two years would be hard to justify.

The firm upgraded this multifunctional handle to its own page in 2024, a visible and growing commitment that fits its barrier-free system direction, so dropping it would contradict that publicly signaled choice.

This multi-model lever line has been on the website for two years with sunk tooling costs, and in a durable architectural hardware range modest early visibility can still be attributed to normal planning-cycle lag.

The award-winning FSB 1289 collection is a publicly celebrated flagship with its own page, so dropping it would write off a heavily promoted investment and contradict the firm's design-led positioning.
